meta.title: Second search sweep: data points with provenance (data only)
meta.status: collection only. Not merged, not published, not wired into the manifest. Nothing here is drawn on the map.
meta.purpose: Find further connections of people, organisations, NGOs, money and contract jobs to the suspected takeover of the Constitutional Tribunal, and keep the provenance of every data point.
meta.tool: web search tool that returns result titles and URLs only. No page text. 45 queries (44 standard, 1 extended).
meta.access_note: No page was opened. All 35 research hosts tested (listed below) refuse the connection under the environment network policy; only package-registry hosts answer. Every data point therefore rests on a search-result title (and URL path) and is marked access=search_result_title_only. Pages that need reading are listed in priority_reads.

how_to_read_a_data_point.title_as_returned: exact text of the result title. Where it is lower-case without punctuation it is the URL slug, not the typeset headline (title_note says so). Where the title is a site banner, descriptor_from_url_slug gives the slug text.
how_to_read_a_data_point.translation_literal: literal translation of Polish titles, written for this file, not official; null where none was given.
how_to_read_a_data_point.date_from_url: a date only where the URL path contains one (basis=url_path). Otherwise null; no date is inferred except where a field says "inference".
how_to_read_a_data_point.ref: Qnn#k = query number nn, result rank k (see queries and the raw results file).
how_to_read_a_data_point.proposed_label: fact | alleged | speculation | unproven_conspiracy. Applies to what label_scope says, usually that the item was published and what it reports. It is a proposal pending a read of the page, not a verdict.
how_to_read_a_data_point.map_status: new_node | new_edge | new_event | extends_existing | already_on_map | context_only | needs_read. Checked by script against the published union (main graph plus manifest companions); map_check records what was checked.

meta.no_link_policy: Searches that found nothing are listed under searched_nothing_found as notes. They are not edges and are never drawn.
meta.party_balance_note: Where a politician appears, the party-side links needed to show his or her own party are listed as gaps (open_decisions), not filled from memory.
meta.excluded_sources_note: Reddit-mirror snapshot pages (reddit.sentinel-team.org), news aggregators (ground.news, inkl.com, marketscreener.com) and Wikipedia mirrors appeared in results; they are not used as evidence except one Ground News item listed beside primary outlets.
